item.title: Security chiefs hail IGP Disu for suspending declaration of Obaigbena, others wanted
item.description: By Emma Nnadozie THE police order suspending the wanted declaration on Arise TV owner, Mr. Nduka Obaigbena and seven others over alleged assassination attempt by Assistant Inspector-General of Police, Olohundare Jimoh, has elicited reactions from some security chiefs in the country, who said that the wanted declaration was done without due process. One of the security chiefs who spoke with Vanguard, said: “It was misappropriate and procedurally flawed” and showered encomiums on the Inspector-General of Police, Olatunji Disu, for his quick response by suspending the wanted declaration The Assistant Inspector-General of Police, Zone 2, Onikan, Lagos, Olohundare Jimoh, last Tuesday, declared Chairman of Arise News and This Day Media Group, Chief Nduka Obaigbena, Managing Director of Nestoil, Dr. Ernest Azudialu-Obiejesi, and seven others wanted over an alleged threat to the life of First Bank Managing Director, Olusegun Alebiosu in a crowed press conference in Lagos. He said the declaration followed an investigation into the delivery of a parcel containing two rounds of 7.62mm live ammunition to Alebiosu’s residence in Lagos. However, in a swift reaction two days later, the IGP, through the Force Public Relations Officer, FPRO, Ani Iniedu suspended the wanted declaration against the suspects and stated that the case has been transferred to the Force Intelligence Department, FID, Abuja, for a thorough and impartial investigation. He also directed the nine individuals to report to the FID, at the Force headquarters , Abuja, between November 26 and 30, 2026. In his reaction, the Director-General of the Institute of Security, Nigeria at the University of Lagos, Mr. Adebayo Akinade, said that the Zone 2 declaration was “misappropriate and procedurally flawed. The IGP’s suspension and transfer to Force Intelligence Department was correct, strategic and has restored public confidence.” Former Director with the Department of State Service, DSS, and currently a security consultant, Mr. Mike Ejiofor, said: “The IGP has the superior order on such matters. When a subordinate makes a mistake, the IGP is in a position to correct it. So, I do not see any conflict in the matter.” In his response the Chairman/Chief Executive Officer of Perfect Security Services Limited, Dr. Patrick Uwagbale saw the incident as “part of a system that is not in order. A good society will do something according to the rules. Even if the allegation is true or not, it is unheard of that someone as IGP would be on seat and a subordinate had the audacity to take such a decision on such a high profile incident without authorisation from the IGP who ordinarily should have the last say on such a matter. This type of behaviour clearly shows that our system is not healthy. “Something is wrong somewhere. There is a gap somewhere. I wholly support the decision of the IGP to suspend the declaration by his subordinate.” Recall also that The Chairman of This Day Newspapers and Arise, Nduka Obaigbena

item.title: Lions’ Jared Goff downplays Bears’ role in false start woes, but Detroit O-Lineman isn’t as kind
item.description: Lon Horwedel-Imagn Images Lions’ Jared Goff downplays Bears’ role in false start woes, but Detroit O-Lineman isn’t as kind appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . As the Detroit Lions collapsed to the Chicago Bears on Thanksgiving Day on Thursday, losing 39-35, there is a conversation around the self-inflicted mistakes that the team went through that led to the defeat. While the Lions and Bears game will be remembered for Chicago scoring 29 points in the second half, there is also the topic of Detroit’s false start penalties, which led to an interesting comment from quarterback Jared Goff . The Lions committed four false start penalties, with Juice Scruggs charged with three of them and Christian Mahogany getting the other, as the latter said that players on Chicago were “emulating snap counts.” “No b****ing and complaining. We had self-inflicted wounds,’ Mahogany said. ‘The league can investigate.” Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) Mahogany said that “the guards wear microphones, so that you can hear the QB on TV,” further saying that “they’ll be able to hear “clear as day” what was going on, according to Brad Galli. Goff would downplay the situation: “I don’t think that should be overblown. I think it happened a couple times,” Goff said, via Galli. “The officials talked to them, and if they were trying to simulate the snap count, or if they weren’t, I don’t know, they can probably say they aren’t; it’s impossible to officiate, and they’ll never throw a flag on it. It happens. This isn’t the first game it’s happened. We got to be able to handle that a little bit better than we did.” Bears’ Jeffery Simmons responds to Lions’ Christian Mahogany The Lions’ qualms received a response from the Bears, specifically star defensive tackle Jeffery Simmons, who said that “there’s a lot of crying on that side of the ball when that happened,” according to MLive.com. “But as a defensive lineman, when your quarterback checks, I’m allowed to say he can check into a run. When Jared checked, and I said, ‘It’s a run; they’re checking to a run,’ it’s not my fault your center jumped,” Simmons said. At any rate, Detroit let go of the rope after a 19-10 halftime lead and now is 8-3 on the season, putting them second in the NFC North. item.title: Dylan Harper could be back in action when Spurs host Lakers on Friday
item.description: San Antonio Spurs guard Dylan Harper reacts to a 3-pointer by teammate Julian Champagnie, not pictured, during the fourth quarter of an NBA game against the Los Angeles Clippers on Thursday, Nov. 19, 2026, in San Antonio. The Spurs won 124-112. (Sam Owens/San Antonio Express-News) Spurs guard Dylan Harper could make his return to the court as soon as Friday night after the team listed him as questionable for its showdown with the Los Angeles Lakers at the Frost Bank Center. Harper has missed the last four games after he suffered a left hip external rotator strain late in the Spurs' 105-93 loss to Detroit on Nov. 17. The injury was expected to sideline him for two to three weeks, but the Spurs upgraded him to questionable after Wednesday night's 116-111 loss at Portland. Harper, 20, ranks as the Spurs' second-leading scorer behind Victor Wembanyama at 18.4 points per game. He's also averaging 5.4 rebounds and 4.5 assists in 15 appearances. The Spurs are 3-1 without Harper, who has been replaced in the starting lineup by Julian Champagnie. In other injury news, the Spurs upgraded guard De'Aaron Fox to questionable after he sat out the last two games with a bruised right shin. The Spurs started Harrison Barnes the last two games to round out a starting lineup that included Stephon Castle, Devin Vassell, Champagnie and Wembanyama. Forward Tobias Harris remains out with a left calf strain. The 15-year-veteran suffered the injury early in training camp after the Spurs signed him in the offseason to a two-year, $31 million contract. Friday's NBA Cup in-season tournament group play matchup features the two top teams in the Western Conference in the Lakers (15-3) and the Spurs (15-4). Set to start at 8:30 p.m., the game will be televised by Prime. Subscribe There’s more to San Antonio with the Express-News. Subscribe today for just 25¢. item.title: Travis Kelce’s feelings about Dancing with the Stars winner Ezra Frech revealed with social media move
item.description: Travis Kelce’s feelings about Dancing with the Stars winner Ezra Frech revealed with social media move appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . Ezra Frech was recently crowned the Dancing with the Stars Season 35 winner alongside Daniella Karagach, and Travis Kelce made a recent social media move in support of his historic feat. Frech made history as the first-ever amputee and Paralympian to win DWTS on Nov. 24. In honor of the two-time Paralympic gold medalist bringing home the Len Goodman Mirrorball Trophy, comedian and actor Adam Sandler shared a photo of them holding the trophy on Instagram, congratulating the winning duo. View this post on Instagram Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) Sandler didn’t add a caption to the post, but Kelce did give the comedian’s post a “like” in support. Frech went to the comment section to thank Sandler for the congratulatory post, “LOVE YOU ADAM!!!! During Frech’s performance, his leg detached mid-routine during his freestyle dance to Linkin Park’s “Numb.” Despite the mishap, he was able to recover and finish his routine to win a perfect 30-30 score. He later shared how much being a part of the show meant to him. “I dreamt of getting the opportunity to be a small role in representing my community. And this is the biggest stage there is,” Frech said. As for Kelce, he didn’t expand over just sending a “like” Frech’s way but as an athlete himself known to have the spotlight on him and his team, he most likely resonated with the power of resistance one feels when achieving a goal. The Kansas City Chiefs tight end recently had a career milestone when he played in his 100th NFL game on Nov. 22 against the Arizona Cardinals. Kelce and the Chiefs won 34–7 over the Cardinals and the tight end had an impressive gameplay with six catches, 74 receiving yards, and two touchdowns. “Hundred games, dude, it feels pretty awesome right now,” Travis told his older brother and co-host, Jason Kelce, on their New Heights podcast this week. “To think about the legacy of that stadium, man, and it’s pretty crazy to think they’re moving on from that stadium, because of all the history that’s happened over the years and history of the franchise and everything.” 100 games at Arrowhead had Travis going down memory lane NEW EPISODE OUT NOW!!! pic.twitter.com/qfBSY7F9ML — New Heights (@newheightshow) November 25, 2026 “You know it’s been home for me for 14 years, and it’s been one of my favorite places to go to play and to watch not only football, but musical events, and I’ve had so much history and so many things that mean so much to me happen at Arrowhead that a hundred games, it’s pretty awesome to hit that milestone,” he said. Now, Kelce will be suiting up for his 101st game against the Buffalo Bills on Thanksgiving (Nov. 26) at 8:15 p.m. MORE CELEBRITY NEWS How hardships made Jordyn Woods and Karl-Anthony Towns’ married life ‘real easy’ What Ric Flair would tell 76ers’ LeBron Ja

item.title: 2027 Elections: INEC raises alarm, warns violence may hurt polls
item.description: By Ikechukwu Nnochiri and Omeiza Ajayi ABUJA — Chairman of the Independent National Electoral Commission, INEC, Prof. Joash Amupitan, yesterday, warned that the raging waves of political violence could harm the 2027 general elections. Listing Lagos, Edo, Ekiti, Enugu, Ebonyi, Delta, Cross River, Oyo and Benue as states where incidents of political violence had been recorded, he warned political parties and their supporters against violence, intimidation and the use of thugs, saying such activities could discourage voter participation and undermine the credibility of the 2027 elections. He also cautioned political parties against signing peace accords in Abuja while allegedly sponsoring violence in states, insisting that no political ambition was worth the blood of Nigerians. According to him, attacks have targeted campaign convoys, town hall meetings, party offices and supporters, while INEC officials, staff and ad hoc personnel have also suffered harassment, intimidation and physical attacks by supporters and agents of political parties, both within Nigeria and abroad. It also said it was working with closely with the Nigeria Police Force and allied security agencies to prosecute electoral offenders. The warning came as INEC and security agencies met in Abuja to strengthen election security ahead of the 2027 polls. This came as the Federal Government assured voters, politicians, electoral officials and political parties of protection before, during and after the elections. Speaking at a Strategic Election Security Conference jointly convened by INEC and the Office of the National Security Adviser, ONSA, Amupitan said Nigeria had witnessed a disturbing escalation in political intolerance, inflammatory rhetoric and coordinated attacks since the commencement of campaigns in August 2026. Addressing political parties, he said: “Signing peace accords in Abuja while tolerating or financing thuggery in the states is a contradiction our democracy can no longer afford.” He warned that INEC would not succumb to threats or intimidation. “We will neither be intimidated nor blackmailed into compromising our neutrality, and every attack on INEC personnel, facilities, or materials will be met with the full weight of the law,” INEC chairman said. Amupitan said responsibility for electoral violence extended beyond those directly involved in attacks, stressing that political party leaders must be held accountable for the conduct of their candidates and supporters. He said: “Accountability does not end with the foot soldiers who throw stones or wield weapons,” adding that “party leadership bears moral and political responsibility for the conduct of its candidates, campaign councils, and youth wings”. Violence may suppress voter turnout The INEC chairman identified three major consequences of political violence for the electoral process, including voter suppression, threats to the safety of electoral personnel and the possibility of post-election violence. item.title: Why even Trent Williams envies the high point of new 49ers starter Vederian Lowe's career
item.description: San Francisco 49ers offensive tackle Vederian Lowe (76) blocks during an NFL football game against the Arizona Cardinals in Santa Clara, Calif., Sunday, Sept. 27, 2026. (AP Photo/Scot Tucker) (Scot Tucker/AP) Vederian Lowe has picked Trent Williams ' brain and studied the generational left tackle's film since signing with the San Francisco 49ers in March, but the onetime sixth-round pick and part-time NFL starter understands there are limits to what he can replicate. "A lot of the things that he does, I can't do," Lowe said. "Because Trent is one of one." However, there is something Lowe has done that Williams has spent his illustrious 16-season career wishing he could do. On Nov. 17, 2024, Lowe, then with the Patriots, realized every 300-pound man's dream when he caught a 4-yard touchdown from quarterback Drake Maye in a loss to the Chargers. Asked where his lone catch ranks among his career highlights, Lowe smiled and invoked Williams, who is catch-less and has long lobbied head coach Kyle Shanahan for a goal-line pass. "That (catch) might be number one because they don't come by - I was talking to Trent and even Trent doesn't have one," Lowe said. "So I'm like, ‘OK.' That's up there for sure." The lofty ranking Lowe has assigned his reception speaks to the rarity of such a snag. But it also speaks to the modest number of highlights he's collected in a five-season career that has included 25 starts, just four since Jan. 5, 2025. But that could be changing. Last Sunday, in a 35-10 win over the Vikings in Mexico City, Lowe was unexpectedly thrust into the role of a key starter on a Super Bowl contender when right tackle Colton McKivitz suffered a broken and dislocated ankle in the second quarter . McKivitz's season is over. Lowe's chance to show why the 49ers signed him to a two-year contract with a maximum value of $12 million to serve as their swing tackle is just beginning. "That's why we brought him here," Shanahan said. "Anytime you have a swing tackle - that means you better be capable of starting. He's started a lot of games in this league and has played like a starter. And that's why we targeted him." Lowe is assuming some sizable cleats. McKivitz, 30, was earning every bit of the three-year, $45 million extension he signed last year by not allowing a sack in 327 pass-blocking snaps this season before his injury. The very early returns, however, are promising. On Lowe's first snap after replacing McKivitz, he pancaked defensive tackle Tyrion Ingram-Dawkins on a 10-yard run by Christian McCaffrey . It was the start of a 38-snap performance in which Lowe committed a false start, but he didn't allow a QB pressure on 19 pass-blocking snaps against Minnesota's chaotic, blitz-heavy defense, a unit which leads the NFL in sacks. Lowe did so despite logging most of his snaps at left tackle throughout his career. With a quarter left in the game and Wake Forest up 50 to 22, the game was practically settled — causing ESPN’s analyst Jesse Palmer, host of The Bachelor and The Bachelorette , to turn his attention to the stadium during a dead-ball situation. That’s when he caught a young man and woman in an intense conversation that seemingly had all the markings of a public breakup. “This playoff game is intense, but not as intense as this conversation, though,” said one commentator. “That’s a lot of eye contact.” A Georgia Tech couple appears to have a breakup live on air and the commentators analyze and break it down #StingEm #GoDeacs pic.twitter.com/CQukZ1DRJD — Carter Lowe (@carterl0we) November 21, 2026 COMPLEX SHOP: Shop the brands you love, anytime and anywhere. item.title: NFL Under Fire After Refs’ Controversial Call Wipes Out Eagles TD Following Javonte Williams Fumble During Cowboys Clash
item.description: LANDOVER, MD – DECEMBER 25: Dallas Cowboys running back Javonte Williams 33 reads his blockers during game between the Dallas Cowboys and the Washington Commanders on December 25, 2025 at Northwest Stadium in Landover, MD. Photo by Charles Brock/Icon Sportswire NFL, American Football Herren, USA DEC 25 Cowboys at Commanders EDITORIAL USE ONLY Icon251225004 ©IMAGO/Icon Sportswire An officiating decision in the Eagles-Cowboys game has put the NFL’s review process under scrutiny again. Philadelphia’s touchdown, which came after a Javonte Williams fumble, was taken off the board by the officials, and the play never counted. The officials’ interpretation of forward progress is disputed; some analysts argue Williams did fumble before being ruled down. Nevertheless, the ruling has now prompted fans and analysts to question how the rule was applied and whether the league enforces it consistently across games. “Whistle halts Riq Woolen return after Javonte Williams fumble. Nick Sirianni protested the early stoppage,” Wire Report NFL posted on X . Williams was driving toward the end zone when the ball came loose just short of the goal line in the second quarter. Eagles cornerback Riq Woolen scooped it up and took off for a 97-yard return that looked like a touchdown. Before he got there, the whistle blew. The officials ruled that Williams’ forward progress had already been stopped, which meant the play was dead before Woolen reached the end zone, preventing a TD rather than erasing one. When a touchdown gets erased in a rivalry game, the entire playoff picture shifts. Stay ahead of every controversial call and its impact with EssentiallySports NFL coverage. That ruling carries a harsh consequence, because forward progress calls can’t be challenged. Nick Sirianni had nothing to throw a flag over and no review to ask for, so the Eagles simply had to line up again. Dallas then scored its own touchdown to build the halftime cushion. By the start of the fourth quarter, the Cowboys led 31-17, with Philadelphia having added ten points in the second quarter and seven in the third. The officials’ call on it is now drawing heavy criticism. One fan, whose comment was originally in Spanish, summed up how it looked from the stands: “To me, this was a fumble by Javonte Williams and a potential defensive TD for the Eagles that would have made it 21-17 at halftime. The refs blew the whistle (too early, in my opinion), and that killed the play. Anyway… on to the next one.” Media voices were just as direct. Former ESPN writer Ed Werder pointed to how plays like this are usually handled: “That was a quick whistle on the potential Javonte Williams fumble and Eagles recovery. They usually allow that to play out through the return. Riq Woolen was stopped from a 98-yard return by whistle. Nick Sirianni had a legit argument and made it.” Eagles reporter Brandon Lee Gowton was far less diplomatic, as he said on X, “Absolute horseshit ruling on that Javonte Williams fumble creates

item.title: Eagles vs. Cowboys, live updates: Joe Milton going nuclear in upset bid
item.description: Happy Thanksgiving, Philadelphia Eagles fans. Let’s see if the Birds can score an upset win against the Dallas Cowboys at AT&T Stadium in Week 12 NFL action. The Eagles (3-7) are coming off their first win in two months, beating the Pittsburgh Steelers last Sunday — a victory that played a factor in the Aaron Rodgers-Mike McCarthy drama that has since unfolded. More importantly for the Eagles, their 19-16 victory over the Steelers ended a brutal seven-game losing streak. But now, the Cowboys (5-6) and their high-powered offense awaits Nick Sirianni’s team on Turkey Day. The Cowboys are in the hunt for first place in the NFC East, trailing the division-leading New York Giants (6-3-1). Understandably, Dallas is a heavy 8.5-point favorite vs. Joe Milton and the Eagles, per FanDuel Sportsbook . But can the former Cowboys QB spring an upset against his old team? Milton will need plenty of help from Saquon Barkley, DeVonta Smith and Philly’s defense — which will have its hands full with Ceedee Lamb, George Pickens and Co. The last time these two teams met was in Week 7, when Lamb had two touchdowns, Pickens scored, and the Cowboys won going away, 38-21, at Lincoln Financial Field. We’ll see if the Eagles can keep this one closer — or if it’s more of the same on Thanksgiving in Texas. Stay tuned for updates here throughout the game. FOURTH QUARTER 7:05 — Cowboys 38, Eagles 30 Joe Milton couldn’t keep his ridiculous play going, throwing a bad interception into triple coverage on third-and-16. The Eagles’ defense has to come up with a stop to get the ball back for Milton and the offense to pull off the upset. 9:09 — Cowboys 38, Eagles 30 And just like that, the Eagles are back in it. Joe Milton is having a day. After a 55-yard kickoff return by Britain Covey, the Eagles needed only three plays to find the end zone. Two completions to DeVonta Smith preceded Milton’s 15-yard touchdown scramble to cut the Cowboys’ lead. Nick Sirianni decided to go for the two-point conversion, and the Eagles didn’t get it. A few plays later, Dak Prescott went airborne for an acrobatic, 14-yard touchdown scramble to make it a two-score game again. We have a game. After a huge defensive stop on third-and-short, defensive tackle Ty Robinson blocked the Cowboys’ punt, and Kenny Moore returned it for a touchdown. item.title: Tom Brady breaks his silence with scathing Aaron Rodgers verdict live on Fox
item.description: Photo by Sam Hodde/Getty Images Just about everyone has had their say on Aaron Rodgers’ blockbuster interview on The Pat McAfee Show. Now, Tom Brady has broken his silence on the saga. Rodgers cleared waivers on Thursday afternoon, with the Pittsburgh Steelers preparing for their game on Friday against the Denver Broncos. Whether a team will even look to bring him into their building on the back of his explosive interview remains a huge unknown. The interview on McAfee’s show has certainly split opinions, with some people welcoming the honesty from the future Hall of Famer. Brady does not seem to fall on that side of the divide, with the former quarterback sharing his thoughts on Fox Sports’ coverage of the Dallas Cowboys vs Philadelphia Eagles. What Tom Brady said about Aaron Rodgers’ Mike McCarthy comments No one needs reminding of what Rodgers said on The Pat McAfee Show, with his comments being the major talking point across the NFL over the last 24 hours. Brady was left far from impressed, with the 49-year-old finally speaking out on the matter. “Yeah, and that’s one thing I just think in response to that: the sanctity of an NFL locker room is a very sacred place, and we shouldn’t ever lose track of that as players. It’s a privilege to be in that locker room. You’re fighting with your teammates, you’re fighting with your coaches, and you’re always acting as a team together. It shouldn’t be a place for private things to become public. That’s what I’ll say,” Brady said on Fox Sports. This has been a running theme with a lot of former players and coaches, with Rob Gronkowski also unimpressed with Rodgers . For some, the 42-year-old has only spoken the harsh truths, but for others, he has broken the trust of an NFL locker room. “Certainly a Hall of Fame career, and he’s a tremendous player. And that’s not going to detract from what he plays for, which is a fortunate lot of teammates over the years. What made him a great teammate was that he cared about his teammates,” Brady added. Given the view of Brady and some other former players and coaches, it is difficult to see how Rodgers would be accepted by another team before the end of the season. It really does look like this is how he is going to bow out of his incredible NFL career. item.title: Will the Utes polish off an undefeated regular season in style vs. West Virginia?
item.description: Utah Utes head coach Morgan Scalley coaches during an NCAA football game against the Idaho Vandals at Rice-Eccles Stadium in Salt Lake City on Thursday, Sept. 3, 2026. | Tess Crowley, Deseret News This article was first published in the Ute Insiders newslett er . Sign up to receive the newsletter in your inbox each Wednesday night. For the third time in modern program history, the University of Utah football team will play the regular-season finale at Rice-Eccles Stadium with an undefeated season on the line. In 2004 and 2008, the Utes, then in the Mountain West Conference, faced off against rival BYU for a trip to a BCS bowl game. In 2026, the stakes are even higher, though Utah’s “rivalry week” opponent is about the furthest thing from a rival. When the Utes and West Virginia Mountaineers meet on Black Friday (7 p.m. MST, Fox), a College Football Playoff berth is at stake. With a win, No. 2 Utah would essentially clinch the program’s first-ever spot in the College Football Playoff, no matter what happens in the Big 12 championship game on Dec. 4 against Texas Tech or BYU. After defeating BYU, Arizona and TCU in November, the Utes close out the regular season as 26.5-point favorites against West Virginia. The big storyline for the Mountaineers (5-6, 2-6 Big 12) is the health of star quarterback Michael Hawkins Jr., who has thrown for 2,258 yards and 14 touchdowns and rushed for 1,055 yards and a nation-high 21 touchdowns this season. Hawkins played through an injured ankle in last Saturday’s loss to Houston, but the talented quarterback went out for good late in the fourth quarter after a hit and was listed as doubtful on Wednesday night’s availability report. If Hawkins is unable to play, West Virginia’s starting quarterback will be Scotty Fox Jr., who played the final two series in the Houston game, which both ended in punts. Fox, a sophomore, has played sparingly this season, but last year, he started in the back half of the season and finished with 1,276 passing yards and seven touchdowns with six interceptions on 59.4% accuracy and 201 rushing yards and three scores. While Fox is no stranger to starting, there’s a reason why Hawkins won the job this year, and his absence would make the Mountaineers’ slim upset hopes even slimmer. No matter who starts at quarterback, the Utes are prepared for an up-tempo West Virginia offense. “The speed at which they go, their tempo, because you got to get lined up, you got to get ready, you got to get your call,” Utah head coach Morgan Scalley said. “They are the best in the Big 12, in my opinion, of stressing you with pace.” The Utes have faced up-tempo teams before, but the Mountaineers are on another level, especially when Hawkins is running the show. “We’ve definitely played against uptempo, but these guys do it a little differently,” Utah linebacker Elijah Elliss said. “Their offense is explosive and it comes from, I think, catching people off guard. “Obviously they have very talented backs, quarterba

item.title: Seven wins later, ex-UFC prospect Nick Maximov still waiting for call back — ‘What do I gotta do?’
item.description: LAS VEGAS, NEVADA - MAY 14: Nick Maximov reacts after his submission loss to Andre Petroski in a middleweight fight at UFC APEX on May 14, 2022 in Las Vegas, Nevada. (Photo by Jeff Bottari/Zuffa LLC) Former prospect Nick Maximov was not technically released by Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC) in 2022. The promotion simply allowed his contract to expire and decided against offering him another one. Nearly four years and seven victories later, that distinction probably does not make the rejection sting any less. “After my injury, it just seemed like they didn’t want to re-sign me,” Maximov told MMA Mania recently. “I fought out my contract, so technically I wasn’t released. It was like, ‘We just don’t want to re-sign you.’ I was like, ‘F—k! Damn, that sucks.’ I didn’t know what else to do.” Maximov entered UFC as an undefeated prospect from the Nick Diaz Academy . After defeating a much larger Oscar Cota on Dana White’s Contender Series , he joined the promotion and scored consecutive victories over Cody Brundage and Punahele Soriano . Losses to Andre Petroski ( watch highlights ) and Jacob Malkoun followed, leaving Maximov with a 2-2 UFC record when his four-fight contract expired. “I feel like I’m way more mature and just better now,” Maximov said. “I’m doing whatever I can, but it’s just hard to get in.” Getting into UFC once is difficult. Getting back after the promotion has already moved on is considerably harder. UFC parts ways with dozens and dozens of fighters every year , and most never receive another opportunity. Those who return often need a lengthy winning streak, several finishes, a short-notice opening, and someone behind the scenes willing to push their name at precisely the right moment. Maximov appears to have completed most of that checklist. The 28-year-old did not compete for almost two years after his UFC departure because of nagging injuries, but he has remained unbeaten since returning in Aug. 2024. Maximov has recorded seven victories across eight appearances, with one no contest caused by an accidental eye poke mixed into the run. He has earned two technical knockouts and one submission during that stretch. Most recently, Maximov moved up to Light Heavyweight and defeated Wildemar Santos by unanimous decision in the LFA 243 main event, improving his professional record to 15-2 (1 NC). AND STILL!!! 💥 Nick Maximov defends the middleweight title by KO! [ #A1C34 | Live on UFC Fight Pass ] pic.twitter.com/ynUBOT9Ugo — UFC FIGHT PASS (@UFCFightPass) March 28, 2026 “Seven straight,” Maximov said. “It’s like, bro, what are we doing? That’s crazy. I knocked the dude out. I knocked a bunch of other people out, and it’s like, I just don’t even know.” Maximov said he has occasionally heard from people connected to the promotion, but those conversations have repeatedly led to another requested fight instead of a contract. “What they kept telling me was, ‘The next one,’” Maximov said. “‘Did you get a finish?’ Then I get a finish, an

item.title: Under-the-radar trade piece could fill out Padres’ bullpen depth in 2027
item.description: ATLANTA, GA - SEPTEMBER 22: Relief pitcher Hunter Stratton #65 of the Atlanta Braves looks back at the outfield video board during the Monday evening MLB game between the Atlanta Braves and the Washington Nationals on September 22, 2025 at Truist Park in Atlanta, Georgia. (Photo by David J. Griffin/Icon Sportswire via Getty Images) | Icon Sportswire via Getty Images Welcome to our series grading every member of the San Diego Padres’ 40-man roster. The roster being evaluated is current as of Oct. 18, prior to the end of the World Series. Because of that, it will include players who will be free agents once the postseason concludes. Each player will be graded on their performance in the 2026 season, including the playoffs. That performance will be weighted based on how much time the player spent with the team (availability is the best ability). Hunter Stratton Stratton wasn’t drafted until the 16th round in 2017. He was a fastball pitcher with a solid slider as his secondary pitch. He’s yet to put it together at the big-league level. Stratton spent the majority of his career with the Pittsburgh Pirates before being traded to the Atlanta Braves in 2025. He’s mostly been a depth piece, only pitching 72 innings in the last four seasons. Overall Grade: B Because of that, it’s hard to grade Stratton’s 2026 with the Padres. He didn’t spend any time with the big-league club, but pitched for the Triple-A El Paso Chihuahuas down the stretch. Stratton threw 18 2/3 innings for the minor-league affiliate to fantastic results. The right-hander posted a 1.93 ERA, 1.29 WHIP and .235 opponent batting average. That’s a smaller sample size, but the results are solid. Stratton has been phenomenal in the minor leagues over the last two seasons. He’s posted sub-3.00 ERAs in each of the last two years. Across 88 1/3 innings, Stratton owns a 2.85 ERA and 85 strikeouts. The righty has never been a strikeout pitcher, but he’s able to find creative ways to get outs. With that in mind, it seems likely that the Padres hold onto Stratton as bullpen depth for the dog days of summer. The Friars have one of the deepest bullpens in the game, but they always seem to be adding more arms in order to bolster their depth. Stratton could very well earn himself a call up later in the year if he pitches well enough in Triple-A.

item.title: 'Good one': Patriots star abruptly ends interview after host tells him to lay off the pumpkin pie
item.description: Credit: Rich Storry-Imagn Images / WEEI Listed at 6’1″ and 234 pounds, New England Patriots linebacker Robert Spillane falls well within the typical range of an NFL linebacker. But at least one Boston-area radio host wants to make sure that weight doesn’t start creeping up on account of Thanksgiving dinner. The Patriots are slated to play the lowly Los Angeles Chargers on Sunday as they try to course-correct their season after losing starting quarterback Drake Maye, and the team’s defense is expected to be a large part of that equation. Spillane ranks 45th out of 81 eligible linebackers per PFF, and there are certainly voices in New England that would like to see a bit more production out of him. But overall, linebacker is far from the most pressing issue on the roster. Perhaps that’s why Spillane took exception to a joke thrown out by Boston sports radio host Greg Hill on Wednesday, who hosts The Greg Hill Show on WEEI. In an attempt at some light razzing, Hill told Spillane, “maybe just one piece of pumpkin pie [this Thanksgiving], because we need you to have your feet under you on Sunday.” Patriots linebacker Robert Spillane hangs up on @TheGregHillShow “Good one” lol https://t.co/SdgFRyEjii — Savage (@Savageboston) November 25, 2026 “Good one. Have a good one,” Spillane replied, abruptly ending the interview. Hill appeared shocked. “I was kidding,” he said in disbelief. “I think he was very upset by that. Now I feel bad.” Maybe Spillane wasn’t in the best of moods to begin with, and Hill’s joke just hit at a poor time. Or maybe there was some genuine resentment from a world-class athlete receiving diet advice from a sports radio host. Either way, it’s safe to say Spillane might not be reappearing on Hill’s show anytime soon. The post Robert Spillane abruptly ends radio interview after host tells him to take it easy on the pumpkin pie appeared first on Awful Announcing .

item.title: The token factory never sleeps
item.description: Agentic AI has supercharged demand for inference infrastructure. According to Goldman Sachs, token consumption is set to jump 24-fold to 120 quadrillion tokens per month between this year and 2030. Enterprises, wary of frontier model sticker shock, are now building their own GPU estates to cope. Those enterprises shouldn't blindly follow hyperscalers' lead when taking AI inference kit into production. The indicators of success for such companies are different than those for a frontier model provider, and so are the constraints. DIY AI infrastructure at the enterprise level has to earn ROI quickly, meaning that enterprises must focus on sustained operation. That makes engineering criteria such as uptime, heat and power, service windows, and deployment times doubly important. The performance benchmarks that hyperscalers focus on won't matter nearly as much to the average bank or retailer. ASUS is presenting the ASUS NVIDIA HGX Rubin System , built on the NVIDIA HGX Rubin NVL8 platform, as a worked example of sustained AI inference infrastructure. It announced two models at NVIDIA GTC Berlin in October: the 3U hybrid-cooled XR R1I12B-M1BHFS and the 2U fully liquid-cooled XR R1I12B-M1BLFS . Agents change the compute bill Agents represent a hockey stick curve for token consumption because an agent isn't a single prompt. It loops until the job's done, often spawning other versions of itself in the process. This is how it breaks a goal into steps and works through them iteratively. While training is a batch workload, agent inference is a production service that runs around the clock and only gets bigger. NVIDIA is making each generation of systems more powerful than the last to keep up with the demands of both. Running at scale, day after day, is another matter. A useful way to think about the infrastructure that does it is as a token factory: it takes in power, data and GPU compute and turns out tokens. What counts is throughput, meaning how many tokens, and how many users, the same power and floor space can serve, hour after hour. Enterprises move from pilots to AI factories Enterprises are moving ahead quickly with their AI factory projects. According to Deloitte's AI infrastructure survey , published in March, 64 percent of respondents have started limited or at-scale AI factory deployments, while 88 percent expect to do so by 2028. They are spending more on AI infrastructure to do it: 86 percent expect their budgets to increase over the next three years. Enterprises have different problems from hyperscalers and frontier model companies, though. Model builders often get to design greenfield campuses around their GPUs. Conversely, enterprises are often working with small operations teams in existing datacenters that may not have been built with AI in mind. That means they need to think harder about maintenance windows, existing management tooling and predictable deployment. And they'll often be retrofitting halls whose racks rarely draw more than 30

item.title: Eagles’ Saquon Barkley, Dallas Goedert both suffer injuries during Thanksgiving tilt with Cowboys
item.description: Kevin Jairaj-Imagn Images Eagles’ Saquon Barkley, Dallas Goedert both suffer injuries during Thanksgiving tilt with Cowboys appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . As the Philadelphia Eagles face the Dallas Cowboys on Thanksgiving Day on Thursday, the team has been dealt with key injuries to major offensive players in the first half. While Barkley was featured on the Eagles’ injury report ahead of the Cowboys matchup, his injury situation in the Thanksgiving game is a head-scratcher, as tight end Dallas Goedert has also been impacted. Starting with Goedert, he only recorded one catch for nine yards in the first half before leaving the game with a shoulder injury, as Dave Zangaro wrote that he was initially “questionable to return.” “Dallas Goedert (shoulder) is questionable to return,” Zangaro wrote on X, formerly Twitter. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) Just over 20 minutes later, Zangaro would report that Goedert had officially been ruled out of the contest by Philadelphia, marking him as one of the many injuries the team has dealt with this season. “Dallas Goedert (shoulder) has been ruled out,” Zangaro wrote in another post later. The situation around Barkley is a little more complex than Goedert’s. Eagles’ Saquon Barkley is dealing with a “stinger” When it comes to Barkley, who has dealt with many health issues this season impacting his play, he left the Thanksgiving contest, as he was being “evaluated” for an injury, according to Zach Berman of The Athletic. “Saquon Barkley is now being evaluated for an injury,” Berman wrote on X. The Eagles themselves would label the injury as a “stinger,” saying that he is questionable to return, with Berman noting that the Fox Sports broadcast is reporting that Barkley is “lobbying to go back” in the game. However, the team trainers “aren’t giving him his helmet.” “The broadcast says Barkley is lobbying to go back in and the trainers aren’t giving him his helmet,” Berman wrote. Berman would later say that Barkley is “animated on the sideline,” though he is “not holding a helmet.” At any rate, it remains to be seen how severe of an injury it is for Goedert and what happens with Barkley regarding his availability for the Thanksgiving contest and beyond. item.title: Tom Brady takes dig at Aaron Rodgers amid Mike McCarthy drama
item.description: Tom Brady had a message for Aaron Rodgers as the controversy surrounding the Pittsburgh Steelers quarterback and head coach Mike McCarthy continues to be the biggest talking point across the NFL . The seven-time Super Bowl champion shared his thoughts while calling the Thanksgiving matchup between the Philadelphia Eagles and Dallas Cowboys on Fox, discussing the situation with Kevin Burkhardt. Brady focused on the value of the NFL locker room and why players should be careful about allowing private matters within a team to become public. MORE: Stephen A. Smith reacts to Aaron Rodgers’ comments on Mike McCarthy Tom Brady addressed Aaron Rodgers’ locker room ethics NFL legend Tom Brady. Credit: Kirby Lee-Imagn Images Credit: IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect (Reuters) “The sanctity of the NFL locker room is a very sacred place and we shouldn’t ever lose track of that as players,” Brady said. “It’s a privilege to be in that locker room. You’re fighting with your teammates, you’re fighting with your coaches, you’re always acting as a team together. Shouldn’t always be the place for, you know, private things to become public.” He also explained that his experience playing alongside several great teammates shaped how he viewed the responsibility that comes with being part of an NFL team and stressed that individual interests should never take priority over the collective goal. “I was fortunate to be around a lot of great teammates over the years. And what made a great teammate to me was you cared about your teammates and your coaches and you cared about what the team was trying to accomplish. And that supersedes any individual aspect of your game that you want to promote.” "The sanctity of an NFL locker room, it's a very sacred place" Tom Brady takes issue with how Aaron Rodgers handled his Steelers benching on Wednesday pic.twitter.com/gRRpgcKo41 — Awful Announcing (@awfulannouncing) November 27, 2026 He also reflected on his own career, pointing to the team-first mentality that defined his time in the league. “I played for my teammates. I played for my coaches. There’s nobody wins when the family feuds.” MORE: If Aaron Rodgers’ NFL career ends now, his final throw was TD pass Aaron Rodgers and Mike McCarthy’s dispute turned public Brady’s remarks came after Rodgers publicly criticized McCarthy following his benching in Pittsburgh. Appearing on “The Pat McAfee Show” on Wednesday, Rodgers accused the coach of falling asleep during meetings, missing team activities and struggling to connect with players. He also described McCarthy mistakenly ending a halftime huddle with “1-2-3 Packers” during Pittsburgh’s loss to Philadelphia. The Steelers subsequently released Rodgers, bringing their brief reunion to an abrupt end. The two previously spent 13 seasons together in Green Bay, winning Super Bowl XLV. — Enjoy free coverage of the top news & trending stories with The Big Lead Newsletter —

item.title: Austin Reaves questionable on Lakers injury report for NBA Cup clash vs. Spurs
item.description: Alonzo Adams-Imagn Images Austin Reaves questionable on Lakers injury report for NBA Cup clash vs. Spurs appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The Los Angeles Lakers took another step towards full strength as star guard Austin Reaves was officially listed as questionable on the team’s injury report of their big NBA Cup clash against the San Antonio Spurs . Austin Reaves has missed the last five games de to a heel injury , but following Lakers’ practice on Wednesday, the prevailing thought was that he would try and give it a go against the Spurs. He was a full participant during the team’s live portion of practice, and he acknowledged that it felt like he had broken his foot after landing awkwardly during the team’s win against the Milwaukee Bucks back on Nov. 11. “I tried to play through it and then I drove baseline, planted on it and was like, ‘no I can’t do this.’ So I walked to the back and was in some pretty bad pain. I didn’t think I broke my foot but it sure felt like I broke my foot,” Reaves said following practice on Wednesday. “Not much you can really do. Try to stay off of it as much as possible. There’s not really a certain thing you can do to make the process speed up. You kind of just let time take care of that stuff.” Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) With Reaves potentially back in the lineup, the Lakers’ fate for the knockout round of the NBA Cup hangs in the balance. Should the Lakers defeat the Spurs, they would need a little help from the Portland Trail Blazers to advance to the NBA Cup quarterfinals. Even if they beat the Spurs, should the Warriors defeat the Blazers, the Warriors would have the advantage of claiming the West Group C’s automatic berth. The Lakers lost to the Warriors in head-to-head cup matchups and both would be tied at 3-1 in the standings. Reaves acknowledged the significance of the matchup, but affirmed that his primary goal was to be healthy and feel good regardless of who is next on the schedule. “I want to play … I didn’t get hurt that night in Milwaukee and look at the schedule and be like, ‘I need to be back before the San Antonio game,’” Reaves said. “If I’m back, good, we’ll go to war. But I got to listen to my body and take care of myself.” MORE LOS ANGELES LAKERS NEWS Rich Paul directly asked by Max Kellerman about Anthony Davis-Lakers reunion trade Ziaire Williams’ honest admission amid shifting role for Lakers Lakers’ JJ Redick fires back at intriguing narrative on LA ahead of Spurs clash Austin Reaves breaks silence on injury with Spurs showdown tease Clutch Scoops: Stephen Curry, Kawhi Leonard injury updaters, latest NBA trade intel entering December

item.title: Tom Brady gets honest about Aaron Rodgers' Steelers exit: 'Nobody wins when the family feuds'
item.description: Tom Brady gets honest about Aaron Rodgers' Steelers exit: 'Nobody wins when the family feuds' originally appeared on The Sporting News . Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here . Tom Brady unquestionably had his share of contentious moments during his 23 years in the NFL, but he just about always kept those disagreements in-house. Aaron Rodgers has routinely taken a different approach. While Rodgers often reserves his public criticism of teammates and coaches for after the fact — he sharply criticized the Jets ' regime once his time in New York ended — the four-time MVP ripped coach Mike McCarthy in shocking fashion on Wednesday. Brady made it clear during Thursday's broadcast of Eagles vs. Cowboys that he would have approached Rodgers' situation much differently in his first comments on the matter. Here's a look at what Brady had to say. MORE AARON RODGERS: Aaron Rodgers slams Mike McCarthy for sleeping during meetings, more Top landing spots for Aaron Rodgers 5 reasons Steelers benching Aaron Rodgers was a costly mistake Aaron Rodgers-Mike McCarthy relationship timeline Tom Brady opens up about Aaron Rodgers' Steelers exit Brady addressed the fallout from Rodgers' benching and release during Thursday's Fox broadcast, telling Kevin Burkhardt that the locker room should be kept "sacred" after Rodgers made several claims about McCarthy. "The sanctity of an NFL locker room is a very sacred place, and we should never lose sight of that as NFL players," Brady said, with Burkhardt calling it a "sad way to end" if this is indeed the conclusion of Rodgers' career. "The sanctity of an NFL locker room, it's a very sacred place" Tom Brady takes issue with how Aaron Rodgers handled his Steelers benching on Wednesday https://t.co/gRRpgcKo41 — Awful Announcing (@awfulannouncing) November 27, 2026 Brady stopped short of calling Rodgers a bad teammate, but he certainly seemed to imply it. "I was fortunate to be around a lot of great teammates over the years, and what made a great teammate to me was you cared about your teammates and your coaches, and you cared about what the team was trying to accomplish," Brady said. The future Hall of Famer discussed his own motivations during his career, explaining that he played for the individuals around him. "I played for my teammates, I played for my coaches. Nobody wins when the family feuds." While Brady didn't directly compare himself to Rodgers, the implication was pretty clear. Rodgers passed through waivers unclaimed on Thursday, and it's unclear whether he will get another chance to play in the NFL. MORE: Art Rooney II makes clear statement about Mike McCarthy's future

item.title: Australia's sandpapergate probe to also include 2017-18 Ashes
item.description: Australia won the 2017-18 Ashes series against England 4-0 [Getty Images] Cricket Australia's fresh independent probe into the sandpapergate scandal has been widened to include the 2017-18 Ashes series against England. The terms of reference for the independent forum have been published and the scope will include "ball-management practices in the Australian men's team during the 2017–18 season", which includes the Ashes series Australia won 4-0. Also included are all four Tests of the subsequent South Africa tour and the investigation which followed when the ball-tampering scandal emerged. Cricket Australia has pledged to publish the full independent report and recommendations within 30 days of receiving them. All those involved in Australia's 2018 tour of South Africa will be invited to speak to the independent forum, though none will have to do so and no retrospective sanctions will be handed out. The scandal was reignited by the release of former batter Usman Khawaja's autobiography. In it, Khawaja claimed the entire team knew about ball-tampering in the third Test of their series against South Africa in Cape Town. The four frontline bowlers in that 2018 team - Josh Hazlewood, Mitchell Starc, Nathan Lyon and current Test captain Pat Cummins - have always denied knowledge of the plan to use sandpaper on the ball. Cummins has called Khawaja's recollection of events "nonsense". However, former team-mates David Warner and Cameron Bancroft - two of three players who were banned for their part in the scandal, alongside Steve Smith - have backed Khawaja's version of events. "All participants in Australia's 2018 tour of South Africa, including players and support staff, will be invited to take part in the Independent Forum, as will CA management and directors at that time," Cricket Australia said. "While all involved will be encouraged to participate, there will be no compulsion to do so. All materials supplied will be treated as confidential unless otherwise stated by the participant and no sanctions will be retrospectively applied. "Participants can choose to attend the Independent Forum in person, online and/or provide information via written accounts or through relevant documents and materials." The forum will be open for six weeks. "This is an opportunity to provide their accounts in a safe environment and to provide the CA Board with relevant information including about the events of that tour and resultant investigation," CA chair David Boon said. "We are acutely aware of the enormous toll the renewed focus on this tour eight years ago has had on those involved and their welfare remains our main priority. "This forum is the best opportunity for people to speak and be heard, and for CA to listen and learn. "Publishing the report in full is part of our commitment to transparency, and to be open with cricket fans about what we learn. "It is also very important to understand that it will not seek to sanction or recriminate." Cummins retains Cricket

item.title: Reporter notices worrying flaw with the Bills’ new $1.4B stadium amid extreme weather
item.description: Photo by Joe Hrycych/Getty Images The new Highmark Stadium has endured its first real weather test on Thanksgiving ahead of the Buffalo Bills vs Kansas City Chiefs. Rain has been pouring down in Buffalo for a number of hours ahead of kickoff on this Thanksgiving Thursday. The game will mark the new $1.4 billion stadium’s first real experience of hosting a game in the extreme elements. This is certainly something the Bills fans will be used to, but it seems as if the team’s state-of-the-art stadium is already struggling to deal with the harsh conditions on what is its first real test. New Buffalo Bills stadium shows worrying flaw amid extreme weather Rain is certainly not uncommon in Buffalo , with the winter months also seeing considerable snowfall. Despite the significant amount of money spent on the new home of the Bills, it seems as if the drainage system has been unable to keep up with the downpour. “It’s been raining consistently in Buffalo for about two hours. By my view from the press box, the Highmark field is struggling to hold up. The field looks like a golf fairway with nobody replacing the divots,” said Chiefs beat reporter Pete Sweeney on X. This will certainly be a concern to the Bills supporters. A huge amount of money has been invested in building the new stadium, yet some of the bare minimum expectations do not seem to have been met. Poor drainage is going to be a big problem for Buffalo, with the game potentially set to be impacted because of the rain sitting on the surface. The decision not to install a roof on the new stadium was a bold choice, and it may already be one coming back to haunt the Bills. item.title: BVB v Bayer – or: Bundesliga’s best defence v the home hoodoo
item.description: BVB v Bayer – or: Bundesliga’s best defence v the home hoodoo While Borussia last lost in Leverkusen in February 2020 and won four of their next five Bundesliga away games on the Rhine, the Werkself have become something of a bogey team in Dortmund. Marco Reus secured Dortmund’s 20th and most recent home win over Bayer on 6 August 2022, scoring the only goal in a 1-0 victory. Since then, BVB have taken just one point from their three subsequent Bundesliga home meetings. Remarkably, none of the last eight competitive meetings have been won by the home side, with the away team winning every one of the last five encounters! The two clubs met three times last season. Dortmund’s 2-1 win in Leverkusen was followed three days later by a 1-0 defeat in the DFB-Pokal round of 16. The return Bundesliga fixture in April also ended in a 1-0 defeat. BVB enjoying their best campaign in eight years Dortmund’s current home record offers encouragement, however: four wins and a draw, with 10 goals scored and three conceded. Borussia have taken 13 of a possible 15 points in front of their own fans, while Leverkusen have collected just seven points from five away games (two wins, one draw, two defeats). Indeed, BVB are enjoying a historically strong first half of the season. For only the third time in their Bundesliga history, the Black & Yellows are unbeaten after ten matches. They previously achieved this only in 2002/03 under Matthias Sammer and in 2018/19 under Lucien Favre. Another win would take Borussia Dortmund to 27 points – their highest tally after 11 matches in eight years. Kobel with an 81 per cent save rate, Flekken with 58 per cent Borussia’s greatest strength is their defensive solidity. Seven goals conceded in ten matches is the best record in the league. Only Bayern Munich have allowed their opponents fewer big chances than Dortmund (nine). Leverkusen, meanwhile, have already conceded 17 goals, 12 of them away from home. That is five more than BVB have conceded in all their league matches so far this season. Notably, the Werkself have allowed their opponents fewer attempts on goal (112) than Dortmund (124). That makes the difference between the goalkeepers all the more striking. Gregor Kobel has saved 81 per cent of the shots on his goal, compared with just 58 per cent for Leverkusen’s Mark Flekken – the lowest save rate of any Bundesliga goalkeeper. There are also major differences between the two teams when defending corners: while BVB have yet to concede from one, Bayer have already let in three goals this way, the joint-highest tally in the league. In attack, however, both sides have room for improvement: BVB, who were so strong in this area in the first half of the year, have scored just once from a set piece, while Leverkusen have scored twice. Neither team has been awarded a penalty yet. Another late goal? From a substitute? Under coach Carles Martinez, Leverkusen are increasingly focusing on wing play in a 4-2-3-1 formation. The star point guard appears to be trending in the right direction concerning his availability for Friday’s game against the Memphis Grizzlies at Target Center in Minneapolis amid an ankle issue. Ball left Wednesday’s NBA Cup showdown on the road against Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and the Oklahoma City Thunder with just 2:30 remaining in the fourth quarter due to an apparent lower-body injury. He just did not seem too concerned by it,” Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic shared via a social media post on X, formerly Twitter. The 25-year-old Ball appeared to land awkwardly on Oklahoma City big man Isaiah Hartenstein’s feet. He had to be helped off the floor before going to the locker room for further evaluation. He left the contest after scoring 19 points on 7-for-18 shooting from the field and 5-for-9 from behind the arc to go along with seven rebounds and eight assists in 29 minutes of action. The Timberwolves were only ahead by a point when Ball exited the Thunder game, but Minnesota broke away later for a 113-106 win. Now on a three-game winning streak, the Timberwolves could have Ball back in action as they look to stretch their undefeated run when they meet with the Grizzlies again. item.title: Eagles’ Joe Milton unleashes ‘Bazooka Joe’ with bonkers TD pass to DeVonta Smith
item.description: Eric Hartline-Imagn Images Eagles’ Joe Milton unleashes ‘Bazooka Joe’ with bonkers TD pass to DeVonta Smith appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The Philadelphia Eagles ’ offense remains severely limited, but there is one factor that could give them an intermittent boost for the remainder of the season. When Joe Milton becomes “Bazooka Joe,” electricity pulsates through the entire team. A big arm and exploitable Dallas Cowboys defense created the perfect formula for an incredibly impressive Philly touchdown late in the first half of this NFC East Thanksgiving showdown. Facing second-and-4 with a little more than four minutes remaining in the second quarter, Milton let it rip and linked up with wide receiver DeVonta Smith for a 50-yard score. FOX Sports broadcasters Kevin Burkhardt and Tom Brady could not contain their excitement, as a packed AT&T Stadium crowd tried to process what just transpired in the end zone. Milton’s rocket put the Eagles within 11 points of the Cowboys and infused a welcome burst of energy into the visitors’ sidelines. Unfortunately, there were still a few minutes left before halftime. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) JOE MILTON GOES DEEP TO DEVONTA SMITH PHIvsDAL on FOX/FOX One/Tubi Stream on @NFLPlus pic.twitter.com/ZcKIPvq6jS — NFL (@NFL) November 26, 2026 Dallas marched right down the field and capped off an eight-play, 71-yard drive with Javonte Williams’ third TD of the night. The Cowboys squashed the momentum that Milton had built with one mammoth throw and plunged the Eagles back into a three-possession deficit with four seconds left on the clock. The 2024 sixth-round draft pick may need to uncork a couple more bonkers touchdown passes if Philadelphia is going to pull off a Turkey Day comeback. This is surely an unusual experience for Joe Milton, who was celebrating the holiday season with the Cowboys this time last year . Now, they are in his way. Eagles fans are thankful for Milton’s big-play upside, but they would like to see more of it. Dallas led 28-10 midway through the third quarter. item.title: PDP will reclaim Ebonyi in 2027, chairman declares
item.description: …As Odii receives flag, promises economic revival By Jeff Agbodo, Abakaliki The National Chairman of the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP), Abdulrahman Mohammed Takushara, has expressed confidence that the party will reclaim Ebonyi State in the 2027 governorship election through its candidate, Chief Ifeanyichukwu Odii. Mohammed stated this in Abakaliki during the campaign flag-off and presentation of flags to Odii and other PDP candidates in the state. He said Ebonyi had remained a PDP stronghold since 1999 until the party lost power, alleging that its mandate was taken away by the ruling party. The national chairman further alleged that the PDP won the last governorship election in the state but was denied victory, insisting that the party would reclaim its mandate in 2027. He urged residents to vote for PDP candidates, saying the party was determined to change the state’s economic fortunes. In his acceptance speech after receiving the party’s flag, Odii criticised Governor Francis Nwifuru’s spending priorities and promised to revive the state’s economy through industrialisation, agriculture and infrastructure development if elected. The PDP candidate accused the Nwifuru administration of failing to translate increased federal allocations into improved living conditions for residents. He said that despite the increase in federal allocations to the state since 2023, poverty, inadequate electricity, poor healthcare, sanitation challenges and limited economic opportunities remained major concerns. Odii cited a national poverty assessment which, he said, indicated that nearly eight out of every 10 Ebonyi residents lived in multidimensional poverty. He also questioned the government’s expenditure priorities, alleging that it spent N19.78 billion on donations, entertainment and refreshments by the third quarter of 2026, while allocating N9 billion to education and healthcare combined. He further alleged that the government spent less than its approved healthcare budget in 2025, while no expenditure was recorded for textbooks and teacher training. He also claimed that agriculture received less than two per cent of the state’s 2025 budget. The businessman said his experience in business and philanthropy had prepared him for the task of governing the state. He said his foundation had built more than 150 homes for less privileged families, awarded scholarships to over 2,500 Nigerians and provided relief materials to more than 40,000 families. According to him, the foundation also supports over 1,000 farmers annually with agricultural inputs and has empowered 3,000 entrepreneurs through grants and seed capital, in addition to executing rural electrification and road projects. Unveiling his development agenda, Odii promised to promote agricultural mechanisation, irrigation, access to finance and agro-processing facilities to improve farmers’ productivity and earnings. item.title: Kitto violence: Majority of victims suffer in silence – ISHRAI warns
item.description: .. Only 28% of victims report attacks, survey across six South-West states reveals By Chioma Obinna A growing pattern of online deception, blackmail, sexual exploitation and extortion is exposing young Nigerians and other vulnerable people to physical attacks, psychological trauma and even death, with a survey revealing that 71.3 per cent of respondents across six South-West states had experienced Kitto-related violence. The survey also revealed that only 28 per cent of those affected reported their experiences, highlighting the extent of underreporting and the fear, stigma and discrimination that prevent victims from seeking help. The Improved Sexual Health and Rights Advocacy Initiative (ISHRAI), which disclosed the findings, raised the alarm over the trend, warning that victims were increasingly exposed to kidnapping, sexual abuse, blackmail, mob attacks and other forms of violence. The organisation called on traditional rulers, religious leaders, women and youth groups to intensify community awareness, protect vulnerable people and discourage public shaming, discrimination and jungle justice. Speaking at a stakeholders’ engagement involving traditional and religious leaders, ISHRAI’s Programme Manager, Mrs Sophia Lawal, said community leaders must be equipped with the knowledge and referral mechanisms to identify cases of Kitto-related violence and respond appropriately. Lawal said the engagement brought together 20 traditional and religious leaders, including women leaders, to deliberate on the threats facing marginalised people and develop community-based responses. “It’s very important that we have community members, that’s the religious, traditional leaders, and also the women leaders, to have conversations around kitto violence that affects marginalized people in Nigeria,” she said. “And we cannot address these issues without having the right people in the room to deliberate on this matter together so that they are equipped with the right, with the knowledge to actually handle such cases when they are being reported or how to even identify such cases in their immediate community.” Providing details of the survey, an ISHRAI representative said 240 people were interviewed across the six South-West states, with 71.3 per cent indicating that they had experienced Kitto-related violence. He said the organisation’s intervention was aimed at reducing the practice through public education, early identification and effective community response. Explaining how perpetrators operate, he said many exploit social media to establish relationships with unsuspecting young men and women, build their confidence and lure them into physical meetings under false pretences. According to him, victims are sometimes encouraged to travel long distances, with perpetrators offering to pay their transport fares, book hotel accommodation or even arrange flights. However, upon arriving at the agreed locations, some victims reportedly discover that the meetings are traps

item.title: Black Friday hype stems from a desire 'to be part of a collective event', expert says
item.description: Once a strictly US affair, it's become a truly global phenomenon. From shoppers hunting for bargains in Louisiana, to queues forming outside stores in Venezuela, the Black Friday sales event has become the biggest day of the year for retail foot traffic. FRANCE 24's Sharon Gaffney speaks with Olaya Moldes Andres, Associate Professor in Marketing and Strategy at Cardiff Business School. She explains that, beyond the sales, the success of Black Friday may also be due to a desire by shoppers to "join the collective action. Whether it is spending money or going to the mall, shoppers feel part of a collective event, so perhaps this is where the whole hype comes from, to feel that we're being part of something, same thing as Christmas or any other social event".

item.title: ‘Sanitation exercise to hold Saturday as scheduled’ – Lagos Govt
item.description: The Lagos State Government has dismissed rumours of a postponement of the November monthly environmental sanitation exercise, confirming that it will hold across the state on Saturday, November 28, 2026. The exercise is scheduled to take place between 6:30am and 8:30am and will be monitored by government officials across various local government areas and local council development areas. The state government made the clarification on Thursday in a statement signed by Kunle Adeshina, Director of Public Affairs, Ministry of the Environment and Water Resources. The statement quoted the Permanent Secretary, Office of Environmental Services, Dr Gaji Omobolaji Tajudeen, as saying there was no basis for postponing the exercise. “There is no basis to cancel the monthly exercise which has become a rallying point for everyone to stay back and clean their neighbourhood,” Tajudeen said. He added that the November edition would be monitored across the state, as had become a tradition. According to the statement, the First Lady of Lagos State, Dr Claudiana Ibijoke Sanwo-Olu, will lead a team of government officials to monitor the exercise in Eti-Osa Local Government Area. Similarly, another team led by the Head of Service, Mr Olabode Agoro, will monitor activities in Coker-Aguda Local Council Development Area. Explaining the timing of the exercise, Tajudeen said the 6:30am to 8:30am schedule would allow residents to participate in the clean-up without disrupting other activities. He said the timeframe “gives enough room for any form of civic exercise to still be undertaken after the clean-up.” The permanent secretary urged Lagos residents to remain in their neighbourhoods and participate actively in the exercise. He also called on transport unions to use the opportunity to clean their parks and garages before resuming passenger operations at 8:30am. The state government reiterated its call for collective participation in maintaining environmental cleanliness across Lagos State. item.title: Is Spain's snap election being rigged? Debunking viral claims
item.description: Ahead of Spain's snap election on Sunday, allegations of vote rigging - known in Spanish as "pucherazo" - are spreading widely on social media. From claims that undocumented migrants are being illegally registered to vote, to allegations that postal ballots and vote counts could be manipulated, internet users are accusing Pedro Sánchez's government of attempting to rig the election. But these claims misrepresent how Spain's electoral system works, as Vedika Bahl explains in Truth or Fake.

item.title: 2027: Ebonyi CP warns parties against electoral violence
item.description: By Jeff Agbodo, Abakaliki The Ebonyi State Commissioner of Police, Hope Urunwa Okafor, has warned political parties and their leaders against violence, thuggery and hate speech ahead of the 2027 general elections. Okafor gave the warning during a meeting she convened with leaders and representatives of political parties in the state to discuss strategies for ensuring peaceful political activities ahead of the elections. The meeting was attended by representatives of the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP), National Democratic Congress (NDC), All Progressives Congress (APC), All Progressives Grand Alliance (APGA) and Because Of Our Tomorrow (BOOT) Party. The police commissioner reiterated that the Nigeria Police Force remained apolitical and impartial in the discharge of its duties. She assured the party leaders that the command was prepared to provide adequate security for campaign activities, protect lives and property, and maintain law and order across the state. Okafor stressed that no society could thrive in an atmosphere of violence, urging political parties to avoid inflammatory rhetoric, hate speech, personal attacks and other forms of communication capable of inciting violence. She charged party leaders to demonstrate responsible leadership by ensuring that their words and actions promoted peaceful political engagement. The commissioner also urged them to demonstrate zero tolerance for violence among their supporters, rather than merely preaching peace. She called on the political parties to exercise restraint in their public statements and campaign activities and provide the command with timely information on their campaign schedules and other political engagements to enable adequate security arrangements. In their separate remarks, the party representatives commended the commissioner for convening the meeting, describing it as timely and necessary ahead of the 2027 elections. They appealed to the police command to provide adequate security during campaigns and other political activities. The party representatives also requested that candidates contesting various elective positions be invited to similar engagements to strengthen collective efforts towards peaceful elections. item.title: Fountain of Life Church challenges bench warrant against Pastor Jimmy Odukoya
item.description: The Fountain of Life Church has raised concerns over the issuance of a bench warrant against its Senior Pastor, Jimmy Odukoya, by the Lagos State High Court, questioning the procedure leading to the order. In a statement dated November 26, 2026, the church said the development followed proceedings before Justice O. O. Adewunmi-Oshin, which also culminated in the judge’s recusal from the case. The church claimed that Odukoya had not been formally served with the restraining order, originating processes and accompanying documents, either personally or through substituted service, as directed by the court. It also alleged that directives contained in the court’s orders of November 18 and 23 concerning the service of the documents remained unfulfilled. According to the church, its legal representatives had already filed a Notice of Appeal and two separate motions challenging the orders, their enforcement, the court’s jurisdiction and the contempt proceedings. The church further claimed that the matter was not listed on the court’s cause list for November 26 and that members of the media were asked to leave the courtroom before the bench warrant was issued. It said the warrant was issued without the court first determining the pending applications, after which the presiding judge recused herself. “These developments occurred within eight days of the initial ex parte order and before 1 December 2026, the date originally fixed by the court for mention,” the statement said. The church described the circumstances as raising serious questions about due process, fair hearing and the administration of justice. It added that its lawyers were challenging the orders and related procedural and jurisdictional issues before the appropriate courts, including the Court of Appeal. Clarifying the implications of the warrant, the church said its issuance did not amount to a conviction or a final determination of the substantive leadership dispute. The church also maintained that Odukoya remained its duly appointed Senior Pastor and Chairman of the Board of Trustees, describing the position as part of the issues being pursued through the judicial process. It urged members and the general public to remain calm, united and prayerful, adding that it would exhaust all available legal remedies within the Nigerian judicial system. item.title: PDP vows to reclaim Ebonyi in 2027
item.description: ..Odii receives party flag, promises economic revival By Jeff Agbodo, Abakaliki The National Chairman of the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP), Alhaji Abdulrahman Mohammed Takushara, has expressed confidence that the party will reclaim Ebonyi State in the 2027 governorship election through its candidate, Chief Ifeanyichukwuma Odii. Mohammed stated this in Abakaliki during the party’s campaign flag-off and presentation of flags to Odii and other PDP candidates ahead of the 2027 general elections. He said Ebonyi had remained a PDP-controlled state since 1999 until the party lost power, alleging that its mandate was taken away by the ruling party. The PDP chairman further claimed that the party won the last governorship election in the state but was denied victory, insisting that it would recover its mandate in 2027. He appealed to residents to vote massively for the PDP to change the state’s economic fortunes. Speaking after receiving the party’s flag, Odii criticised Governor Francis Nwifuru’s spending priorities and promised to revive the state’s economy through industrialisation, agriculture and infrastructure development if elected. The governorship candidate accused the Nwifuru administration of failing to translate increased federal allocations into improved living conditions for residents. He said despite the increase in federal allocations to the state since 2023, poverty, inadequate electricity, poor healthcare, sanitation challenges and limited economic opportunities remained major concerns. Odii cited a national poverty assessment which, according to him, indicated that nearly eight out of every 10 Ebonyi residents lived in multidimensional poverty. He also questioned the state government’s expenditure priorities, alleging that it spent N19.78 billion on donations, entertainment and refreshments by the third quarter of 2026, while allocating N9 billion to education and healthcare combined. He further alleged that the government spent below its approved healthcare budget in 2025, while no expenditure was recorded for textbooks and teacher training. He also claimed that agriculture received less than two per cent of the state’s 2025 budget. The businessman said his experience in business and philanthropy had prepared him for the task of governing the state. He disclosed that his foundation had built more than 150 homes for less privileged families, awarded scholarships to over 2,500 Nigerians and provided relief materials to more than 40,000 families. According to him, the foundation has also supported over 1,000 farmers annually with agricultural inputs and empowered 3,000 entrepreneurs through grants and seed capital, alongside rural electrification and road projects. Unveiling his development agenda, Odii promised to promote agricultural mechanisation, irrigation, access to finance and agro-processing facilities to improve farmers’ productivity and earnings.
